name: Linear Independence Bipartite Obfuscation
description: The bipartite graph coloring condition `s_u != s_v` is rewritten as a linear algebra constraint: two state vectors `W_u = (s_u, 3-s_u)^T` and `W_v = (s_v, 3-s_v)^T` must form a basis for R^2. The determinant of this matrix evaluates to `3(s_u - s_v)`, which is non-zero if and only if `s_u != s_v`. This hides the graph coloring structure, forcing models to algebraically simplify the determinant to discover the BFS approach, which defeats models relying on surface-level constraint matching.
